name: argentina-transfer-pricing
description: Use this Guide for Argentina transfer pricing in fiscal year 2026: precios de transferencia, operaciones internacionales, vinculados, F.2668, F.4501, Informe Maestro, F.2673, F.2672 and Informe Pais por Pais. It distinguishes the RG 4717 regime for years beginning before October 2026 from RG 5903 for years beginning on or after 1 October 2026. It covers scope, documentation thresholds, arm's length methods, comparables, the interquartile range, local study, master file, simplified reporting and CbCR. It prepares a source-cited working paper for professional review. It does not authorise filing or cover commodity contract registration, APA negotiations or a valuation of unique intangibles.
